definitions.gloss: communication charges; data charges; telecom fees
definitions.explanation: Fees charged for telecommunications services such as phone calls, text messages, and mobile data usage.

examples.japanese: {通信料|つうしんりょう}が{高|たか}い。
{月|つき}の{通信料|つうしんりょう}を{確認|かくにん}した。
examples.english: I checked the monthly communication charges.

examples.japanese: {海外|かいがい}では{通信料|つうしんりょう}が{高額|こうがく}になることがあるので{注意|ちゅうい}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: You need to be careful because communication charges can become very expensive overseas.

notes:
Refers to charges for phone, data, and other telecommunications services. In everyday use, often refers specifically to mobile phone data charges.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {通信料|つうしんりょう}が{掛|か}かる — communication charges are incurred
- {通信料|つうしんりょう}{無料|むりょう} — free of data charges
- {月額|げつがく}{通信料|つうしんりょう} — monthly communication fee
- {通信料|つうしんりょう}を{節約|せつやく}する — to save on data charges

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {通話料|つうわりょう} — call charges (voice calls specifically)
- {通信費|つうしんひ} — communication expenses (broader, used in accounting)
- データ{使用量|しようりょう} — data usage amount
